commit.message:
osr: win: cefclient: Update D3D11 structure to match Metal/EGL

- Support OnPaint uploads and copy shared textures into owned storage
  before OnAcceleratedPaint returns.
- Redraw the last frame on resize/expose.
- Remove the legacy OpenGL renderer and Windows GL handler.
- Preserve cached images on allocation failure and validate bounds.
- Add OsrRendererD3D11Test unit tests, ported from the Metal/EGL tests.

Tested on Windows 11 x64:
- cefclient resize and select popups work in all eight combinations
  of software/shared textures, internal/external begin frames, and
  single/multi-threaded message loops.
- ceftests: 37 renderer tests pass on hardware/WARP; one allocation
  failure test skips after the driver accepts its oversized descriptor
